name: Phrase
tagline: Phrase is an enterprise localisation platform that combines AI translation, translation memory, and glossary management in a unified workflow. It integrates with GitHub, Figma, and major CMS platforms, enabling continuous localisation alongside product development. Global companies use it to maintain consistent voice across dozens of languages.
